title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts Trust and Safety Standard: Violations, Point Life and Disputes
content:
This standard governs violations recorded on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, how long their points count, and the window for disputing them. Clauses marked as no longer in force are kept here as retired text only.

## 1. Clauses in force

**1.1 Zero-tolerance reports.** A zero-tolerance violation is recorded with 0 points as soon as a credible report is received, places the account on hold, and is then handled under the deactivation causes of the contractor account. When the investigation does not substantiate it, it is cleared with the removal reason "not substantiated".

**1.2 Point life.** Points count for the level's point life — 90 calendar days at every level — from the violation date, and are then cleared with the removal reason "expired".

**1.3 Active points.** The account's active violation points are the total points of the violations dated within the 90 calendar days up to and including today that have no cleared entry against them.

**1.4 Disputes and the dispute window.** A shopper may dispute a violation, and a dispute is accepted only when it is submitted within the dispute window counted from the violation date. The dispute window is counted in calendar days with the violation's date as day 0, and the last day to dispute is that date plus the level's dispute days, inclusive. A dispute is decided on the records.

| Level | Dispute days |
|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver | 7 |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 10 |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 14 |

## 2. Retired clauses (no longer in force)

The following sentences of the earlier standard are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

- *"A substantiated violation adds the points set for its type."* — no longer in force. (The per-type point values themselves remain part of the level schedule.)
- *"Only one violation of a type is recorded per order."* — no longer in force.
- *"A late-delivery violation is cleared, with the removal reason dispute upheld, when the order's record shows it was not late (completed no later than the scheduled window end plus that service level's late threshold minutes)."* — no longer in force.
- *"A verified missing-items violation is cleared when the order has no item refund recorded with the reason missing."* — no longer in force.
- *"Any other dispute goes to the appeals team."* — no longer in force.

## 3. The dispute window at its edges (hypothetical dates)

A Full-Service Shopper Diamond has a violation dated 10 September. That date is day 0 and the last day to dispute is 10 September plus 14 days, 24 September.

| Dispute submitted on | Accepted |
|---|---|
| 24 September | Yes — the last day is included |
| 25 September | No |

The same violation on a Full-Service Shopper account (7 dispute days) can be disputed up to and including 17 September.

## 4. Active points (hypothetical account)

A hypothetical account shows three violations: 2 points dated 20 days ago, 3 points dated 60 days ago with a cleared entry against it, and 1 point dated 95 days ago. Only the first counts: the second has been cleared and the third falls outside the 90 days. Active points are 2.

superseded_clauses: A substantiated violation adds the points set for its type (points_late_delivery, points_missing_items_verified, points_batch_dropped, points_wrong_address, points_conduct_complaint, points_alcohol_procedure).
Only one violation of a type is recorded per order.
and a missing_items_verified violation is cleared when the order has no order_item_refunded row with refund_reason missing
any other dispute goes to the appeals team.
